t: A western Anatolian kingdom ruled from Sardis, which under the Mermnad dynasty dominated Asia Minor west of the Halys.
Lydia struck the world’s earliest known coins from electrum carried by the river Pactolus.
Croesus, famed for his wealth, attacked Persia and lost his kingdom to Cyrus the Great around 546 BCE.
dyk: The war between Lydia and Media reportedly ended when a solar eclipse darkened a battle in 585 BCE, which Greek tradition said Thales of Miletus had predicted.
ev: Gyges kills Candaules and founds the Mermnad dynasty
Gyges dies fighting the Cimmerians, who later sack Sardis
The first electrum coins are struck in Lydia
Alyattes drives out the Cimmerians and captures Smyrna
An eclipse ends the war with Media; the Halys becomes the frontier
Croesus becomes king and subdues the Greek cities of Ionia
Cyrus the Great takes Sardis; Lydia becomes a Persian satrapy
